changes: Extracted a shared merge-lineage classifier (packages/main/src/core/validation-lineage.ts: netDiffChangedPaths + classifyMergeLineage) used by BOTH classifyTrustedValidationLineage (validation-evidence-reuse.ts) and validationHeadLineage (validation-evidence-admissibility.ts). It computes a NET endpoint git diff-tree (-z, maxBuffer 1GiB) instead of a per-commit -m union, treats an empty net diff as trusted, and splits the ancestry-vs-diff catch. A new smoke (validation-reuse-merge-lineage-smoke.ts) covers both classifier paths plus negative/robustness/diff-failed cases and is wired into validate.commands; the process-fact contract now tracks the tokens in the shared module.
usage: Automatic. During any DONE convergence whose story branch has merged main, done_prepare/done_required_validate now reuse a fresh PASS validation instead of re-running the full suite, and autopilot_review_submit --deriveBindings no longer hard-throws on the story's own content-unchanged files.
expectedOutcome: A merge that re-introduces content-unchanged story files is trusted (reuse granted); a genuine non-metadata content change still refuses. Running node packages/main/dist/tasks/validation-reuse-merge-lineage-smoke.js prints 'validation reuse merge-lineage smoke passed' and exits 0.
actualTranscript: validation reuse merge-lineage smoke passed (exit 0, 7 test blocks). Full lattice validate PASS at post-merge material e4b8596b (cmdExec PASS, missingRequired 0). classifyMergeLineage returns trusted-descendant for a merge of an unchanged file on both classifier copies, and untrusted for a genuine content change.
outcomeDiff: No diff. Pre-fix: the per-commit git diff-tree -m union flagged the story's own content-unchanged files as untrusted-lineage-path after a main-merge, forcing a redundant ~17 min re-validation and hard-throwing autopilot. Post-fix: the net endpoint diff trusts them while still refusing genuine changes.
limitations: The diff-failed branch is exercised via an injectable changedPathsFn seam used only by the smoke (production always uses the real net diff). Review assurance is degraded single-host 3x1 (probe shows fewer than 2 launcher-ready canonical hosts; only agy is review-ready). Design was cross-host audited (Claude CLI + Agy CLI) before implementation.
pitfalls: Do NOT revert to the per-commit git diff-tree -m union: it re-introduces the merge false positive (caught by the smoke's mutation-resistance assertion and by scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs). An empty net diff MUST stay trusted (byte-identical endpoint trees are strictly safe), never rejected.
